**Title:** `US1: Enforce Manager and Director single-approval limits`

**Base / head:** `feature/us1-single-approval-limits` ← `feature/invoice-approval-assignment` (base ← head). Both local branch refs currently point to `b2726b5`; the base branch has no remote ref, while head `feature/invoice-approval-assignment` exists on origin. To open this PR in the swapped direction, I would put the changes on the head branch and publish the base branch as well.

**Description:**
## Summary
- Enforce Manager approval up to and including 50,000 and Director approval up to and including 500,000, in the Domain service.
- Reject unauthorized/over-limit approvals before mutation and assign approval authorization to Manager/Director roles.
- Add boundary-focused unit tests and a Playwright UI rejection test.

## Business rules and coverage
Unit tests cover Manager at 50,000 and 50,001, Director below 50,000, at 50,001 and 500,000, Director at 500,001, Manager at 500,000, unsupported role, and unchanged invoice fields after rejected approval. The Playwright test signs in as `demo.manager`, submits a 50,001 invoice, attempts approval in the UI, checks the rejection and pending status, and verifies decision metadata is empty. US2’s two-approver flow is not included.

## Validation
- `dotnet test backend/InvoiceApp.sln --no-restore`: 15 passed, 0 failed.
- Targeted Playwright test from `e2e`: 1 passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

## Limitations
This is US1-only; the full E2E suite and mutation tests have not been run. `tasks.md` still marks the successful Playwright task unchecked; I would update it before committing.
